653:t_003:12.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「After all, we can talk with those people called $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$...」

653:t_003:14.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If $$バアル$$ are enemies we can't communicate with, then the $$インベーダー#pilot$$ don't fit that description...!」

653:t_003:15.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「What are you saying?! Since the age of myth, the ravenous destroyers have been deemed $$バアル$$!」

653:t_003:18.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$ seek evolution through $$ゲッター線$$... In that...」

653:t_004:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Tch! They don't care what situation we're in!」

653:t_004:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「They're not distinguishing between us and $$ミケーネ$$!」

653:t_004:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Whether they are $$バアル$$ or not, they are unquestionably our enemies!」

653:t_004:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't care if you call them $$バアル$$ or anything else! I'll crush anyone who comes at us!」

653:t_004:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「They fear no one and advance alongside their comrades... At this rate, they will...」

653:t_004:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「But that is exactly as it should be! They are worthy opponents for me, a hero!」

653:t_004:6.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Come, Earthlings! And you ravenous destroyers! I, the hero $$ガラダブラ$$, shall devour you!」

653:t_004:7.en:
$n
「Looks like you've made up your mind, hero of $$ミケーネ$$!」

653:t_004:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll crush that resolve along with you! So we can survive in this universe!」

653:t_005:0.en:
$$凱$$
「All right! $$ミケーネ$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$ are all wiped out!」

653:t_005:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But to think the $$インベーダー#pilot$$ might not be $$バアル$$...」

653:t_005:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ノノ$$'s unconventional thinking made us realize something unexpected.」

653:t_005:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ahem! $$ノノ$$ gets things done when it counts!」

653:t_005:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Ahem! $$ノノ$$ gets things done when it counts!」

653:t_005:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Ahem! $$ノノ$$ gets things done when it counts!」

653:t_005:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're getting carried away just because the one who keeps you in line isn't here...」

653:t_005:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$隼人$$... Earlier, you said something about evolution...」

653:t_005:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$御使い$$s are probably also responsible for the $$インベーダー#pilot$$ coming to be called $$バアル$$.」

653:t_005:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Those bastards... Just how far do their hands reach...?」

653:t_006:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Having evolved, you could indeed be said to stand at the threshold of $$シンカ$$.」

653:t_006:3.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You have no need to know.」

653:t_006:4.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Yes...! $$シンカ$$ belongs to us!」

653:t_007:1.en:
$$號$$
「Space is warping...! No... Is it about to tear open?!」

653:t_007:2.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Precisely! From this moment on, the void will reign over this universe!」

653:t_007:3.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Earthlings! Offer your lives... your souls, along with your bodies of steel, to us!」

653:t_008:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「U-uaaaagh! You have defeated me, $$ガラダブラ$$, twice!」

653:t_008:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「...I gave it my all. If I must fall to you, then that too is my wish...」

653:t_008:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Warriors of steel who defeated me, called a hero even among the gods of $$オリュンポス$$! You may now call yourselves heroes!」

653:t_008:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「And if you would grant my wish, strike them...! Bring the hammer down upon the $$御使い$$s!!」

653:t_009:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Magnificent, $$ガラダブラ$$. Your death was worthy of a hero's name.」

653:t_009:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「You and we were enemies to the very end. But I won't forget your final wish...」

653:t_009:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「It isn't for your sake... For ourselves and everything we must protect, we swear we'll defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

653:t_100:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「We shall settle this, $$マジンガーＺ$$! And you, $$兜甲児$$!」

653:t_100:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Looks like you remembered my name and $$マジンガー$$'s!」

653:t_100:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You are a warrior worthy of it! Remembering the name of an opponent worth challenging with all one's strength is the courtesy of battle!」

653:t_100:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$ガラダブラ$$! Just what I'd expect from a man hailed as a hero!」

653:t_100:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「But we're going to win! As long as you target Earth for your own ends, we'll fight $$ミケーネ$$!」

653:t_101:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm sick of looking at those three faces, $$ガラダブラ$$!」

653:t_101:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You dare say that, warrior of $$ゲッター線$$! I shall send you to the underworld before that power swallows you!」

653:t_101:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$ゲッターロボ$$ is part of me! No matter how dangerous its power is, it's my partner!」

653:t_101:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Get ready, hero $$ガラダブラ$$! I'll make you taste the terror of $$ゲッター$$ too!」

653:t_102:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's settle this, $$ガラダブラ$$!」

653:t_102:1.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Today, I'll claim your title of hero!」

653:t_102:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「If you want it, take it with your own hands! But do not think it will be easy!」

653:t_102:3.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「My name is the hero $$ガラダブラ$$! I am the mightiest warrior, whose name resounded throughout $$オリュンポス$$!」

653:t_102:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then I'll show you! Strongest or absolute, I'll pierce right through it all! That's what my drill does!!」

653:t_103:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「$$ゼウス$$, god of light! You fool who defies Lord $$ハーデス$$!」

653:t_103:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Enough prattle, $$ガラダブラ$$! If you too are a warrior hailed as a hero, throw everything you have at me!」

653:t_103:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Heh heh heh... So you have seen through my intentions.」

653:t_103:3.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Precisely! Now that I have come this far, Lord $$ハーデス$$' wishes mean nothing! All that matters is fighting a mighty opponent who sets my blood boiling!」

653:t_103:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「$$ゼウス$$, called one of the Three Great Gods of $$オリュンポス$$! I shall subdue that mighty arm with my strength!」

653:t_103:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Come, $$ガラダブラ$$! I am no longer a god of $$オリュンポス$$!」

653:t_103:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「As a single warrior living in this universe, I shall crush your conceit and arrogance!」

653:t_104:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Big Sis... You were fighting with hard work and guts where no one could see, too...)

653:t_104:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(Big Sis... You were fighting with hard work and guts where no one could see, too...)

653:t_104:2.en:

653:t_104:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
($$ノノ$$ didn't understand anything about you, Big Sis... If we can meet again, $$ノノ$$ will apologize to you for that...!)

653:t_104:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
($$ノノ$$ didn't understand anything about you, Big Sis... If we can meet again, $$ノノ$$ will apologize to you for that...!)

653:t_104:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
($$ノノ$$ didn't understand anything about you, Big Sis... If we can meet again, $$ノノ$$ will apologize to you for that...!)

653:t_105:0.en:
$n
(I could gain victory even at the cost of my own life... If that's the only way...)

653:t_105:3.en:
$n
(I don't want to die either...! I won't give up until the very end...!)
